parameters.name: AppId
parameters.description: The ID of the application. You can call the [ListApplication](~~149390~~) operation to obtain this ID.

parameters.name: Enabled
parameters.description:
Specifies whether the setting is active:

- true: The setting is active.

- false: The setting is not active.

parameters.name: NamespaceId
parameters.description: The ID of the namespace. This ID cannot be changed after the namespace is created. The format is \[unk]physical space identifier\[unk].

parameters.name: Region
parameters.description: The ID of the region where the elastic compute unit (ECU) is located.

parameters.name: Threshold
parameters.description: The total number of items that satisfy the threshold expression.
